run_evaluate_s2st: run SeamlessExpressive speech-to-speech translation inference on a TSV data file with audio inputs
build_data_pipeline: build a data pipeline that reads a TSV file, decodes audio, converts to fbank features, and normalizes
generate_text_and_units: generate translated text output and discrete speech units from input audio using the Unity model
synthesize_speech_waveforms: synthesize speech waveforms from discrete units using the PretsselGenerator vocoder
output_evaluation_results: output evaluation results including hypotheses, units, and audio waveforms to a TSV file
